text: Sau mein se sirf\n3 logon ne ye case\nsahi solve kiya!
Clue isi video mein hai.\nDhyaan se dekhna!

Ground floor par\nchhote bhai Aryan\nmare mile!

GUARD BAHADUR\n"Poori raat seedhiyon\nke paas baitha tha"
SHARMA AUNTY\n"Main pehli manzil par\napne ghar mein thi!"
